note: v484: Data-safety release. Your books no longer stop at 1,000 rows — the app used to quietly load only the newest 1,000 of each thing and drop the rest, so older history could go missing from reports with nothing on screen to say so. Editing on your phone and your computer no longer overwrites the other: paid-bill ticks, paycheck amounts, bills, categories, bank nicknames and Paid-from tags now merge instead of the last device winning. Receipt photos are shrunk before upload, so saving one on cell service is quick and takes a fraction of the storage. Every typed pop-up is now a proper in-app form — your passcode is finally hidden while you type it. Dashboard and reports are faster on big ledgers, the Profit & Loss only prints the halves you use, and confirmations are announced to screen readers.
